title.text: Sports & Live: Live Now and Upcoming in three layouts (Cards · Scoreboard · Timeline)

n1.text: Timeline (built, TL1): one row per league, blocks placed by start with estimated length, red now line. A "No time" row holds channels and date-only games. The focused block drives the bottom panel: preview, scoreline, linescore, situation line, Watch / Watch with another game / Game stats.

n2.text: Scoreboard (built, SB2): rows grouped LIVE / STARTING SOON / MORE GAMES / FINAL, the in-player panel's rule. Right side: muted preview, scoreline, clock line, the SB1 situation line and the same three buttons. Finals are dimmed until focused.

n3.text: Channel guide: deferred by the user (2026-11-18). The Now/Next listings source is still open. The board is kept unchanged.

title2.text: Results, the Game page, Team page and Player card

n4.text: Results (built R1 + R2): no right panel, OK opens the Game page. Date rail Today · Yesterday · Earlier ▸ and the "N games live now →" line come with #67 (in batch). Individual sports have their own rows: tennis sets, UFC method, F1 podium, golf winner + top 5.

n5.text: Game page (built G1): header with Reveal (hidden modes only), Watch replay, Follow / ★ Following per team. Sections Game · Box Score · Standings · Highlights. Highlights become playable ESPN clips with #61 (in batch).

n6.text: Live Now cards: drawn game cards with score chips, Just ended strip (#60, built). The Sort control adds "Most exciting" (#43, in batch) with one short why-tag per card.

n7.text: Team page (#62, deferred): record and standings, last 5 with Replay pills, next games with Watch / Remind me, 3 leaders, Follow.

n8.text: Player card (#63, deferred): headshot circle, position, season averages, last 5 lines, next game.

title3.text: In the player, alerts, replays and the component sheet

n9.text: In-player Live now panel (#66 built, #68 in batch): opens on All with filter chips, logo circles on every row, groups Live now / Starting soon / More games / Just ended.

n10.text: Alerts & reminders (#42 + #44, in batch): kickoff "Watch now?" prompt, full-time toast (Show and hidden variants), score-change toast, Reminder set, and the Upcoming card in its Remind state.

n11.text: Replay quarter jumps (#64, deferred experiment): Mark tip-off once, then Q1–Q4 / OT jumps from ESPN play-by-play times, labelled approximate, with ±1 min nudges.

n12.text: Components: every card state, chip, pill, logo circle, panel and Scoreboard row, timeline block and prompt toast. New screens reuse these.

title4.text: V2 proposal (pending approval): one view per tab — Live Now Scoreboard + Stage, Upcoming Agenda + Stage

n13.text: Live Now: one 80 px header line (text tabs, ⚠ source icon, refresh), an 800 px list (LIVE / STARTING SOON / CHANNELS / JUST ENDED, fixed columns, 4 px progress bar) and a fixed 720 px stage: 720×405 media, 64 px scoreline, linescore, Watch + More…. Channels 2–3 and Just ended sit below the fold at these row sizes.

n14.text: Upcoming: the same frame as an agenda. Sticky day headers, slot headers ("3:30 PM · in 2 h 21 m", "6:00 PM · 4 games"), a bell and a green "stream listed" dot per row, one sports filter in the header. ← → jumps a time slot, CH +/− a day.

n15.text: Header on each tab, the one focus language (ring + lift; selected = underline or tint, never white fill), the TV type scale (22 / 26 / 30 / 40 / 64), the five row types and the More… menu.

n16.text: Today's Live Now (schematic) beside V2, with the five biggest differences: header height, row density, fixed stage, focus style, raw text cleaned.
